sentences.text:

Court No. - 73
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 26008 of 2024

Applicant :- Mohd. Firoz
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sudhanshu Pandey

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material brought on record.

2. The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 194/2024,
under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Sahjanwa, District Gorakhpur with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant is husband of deceased and their marriage has taken place about one year prior to the incident.
Only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all persons.

Applicant was working in Bangalore Mohd. Firoz vs State Of U.P. on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72682189/
1 and deceased used to insist to go with him but the applicant was not in a position to take her to Bangalore and she committed suicide due to that reason by consuming some insecticide.

entities.text: Bangalore Mohd. Firoz vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In postmortem report, no injury has been shown on the body of deceased and cause of death could not be ascertained and hence, viscera was preserved.
As per the F.S.L. report, aluminum phosphide was found in the viscera of the deceased.
At the time of the incident, applicant was in Bangalore and he has come back after receiving of information regarding incident.
It is further submitted that during trial informant has already been examined before the trial court and he has not supported the prosecution and turned hostile.
Applicant is in jail since 19.04.2024 and the trial of the case will take long time.
Lastly, it was submitted that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is husband of deceased and that deceased has suffered death due to poison within one year of marriage.

6. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
7. The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant - Mohd. Firoz involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii.
The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

v. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
9. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 10.1.2025 Akbar  Mohd. Firoz vs State Of U.P. on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72682189/
